name: Counting Out Time
summary: Chromie asks you to find five Andorhal Watches in the rubble of Andorhal. They lie in lockboxes scattered through the city.

sections.title: Timepieces in Ruin
sections.body: In Andorhal, Chromie waits at the inn for five watches recovered from lockboxes among the city's rubble. You are to bring them back to her in the Western Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Chromie asks you to bring her five Andorhal Watches from lockboxes among Andorhal's rubble.
The watches are in lockboxes among the rubble of Andorhal.

faq.q: Where do I bring the watches?
faq.answer: Bring the five watches to Chromie at the Andorhal Inn in the Western Plaguelands.
